items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: And I ran into some of my relatives down in Texas, Luther Manning, and he told me the story about my grandfather.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. I remember hearing about that.

And I ran into some of my relatives down in Texas, Luther Manning, and he told me the story about my grandfather. He said when they...whatever signal they gave to go in... He said my grandmother was sitting on the horse asleep! And boy, the Manning family was a sleeping family. We could sleep anywhere...
